package rulefixtures

// scenario for go_perf_layer_algorithmic_complexity_recursive_graph_walk_without_seen_set: Layer: Algorithmic complexity. Flag recursive graph or tree walks that do not track visited nodes for cyclic or shared inputs.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type Node struct {
	Value    int
	Children []*Node
}

func walk(node *Node, result *[]int) {
	if node == nil {
		return
	}
	*result = append(*result, node.Value)
	for _, child := range node.Children {
		walk(child, result)
	}
}

func scenario501Positive(root *Node) []int {
	var result []int
	walk(root, &result)
	return result
}
